setup.title: Set up WebCraft
setup.lockNote: This wizard locks for good once setup is finished.

token.title: Setup token
token.heading: Enter the setup token
token.intro: When WebCraft started, the web process wrote a one-time setup token in its log. Copy it from there to show that you run this server.
token.label: Setup token
token.help: Look for the log line saying this Install has no Superadmin yet.

account.title: Superadmin account
account.heading: Create the Superadmin account
account.intro: This person administers the whole Install: every Workspace, all Staff and the Install settings.
account.name: Full name
account.passwordHelp: At least 12 characters. You'll be asked to add a passkey or an authenticator app next.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.heading: Protect your account with two-factor authentication
twoFactor.intro: A password alone can be guessed or stolen. With a passkey or an authenticator app, signing in also needs something only you have.
twoFactor.recommend: The Superadmin can reach everything on this Install, so we strongly recommend it.
twoFactor.later: You can also do it later from Your account.

email.title: Install email (SMTP)
email.heading: Set up the Install email
email.intro: WebCraft sends invites, password resets and security notices through an SMTP server, such as your email provider's or a sending service's.
email.later: You can skip this for now: until an SMTP is set, these emails are written to the web log. You can set it later in Install settings › Email (SMTP).

modules.title: Modules
modules.heading: Approve the Modules
modules.intro: Modules are features that come with WebCraft, such as Forms or Site analytics. Each runs only once you approve what it asks for. They are ticked: untick any you don't want yet.
modules.later: You can approve or withdraw Modules later in Install settings › Modules.
modules.none: This version of WebCraft has no Modules waiting for approval.

closed.heading: This Install is already set up
closed.intro: It has a Superadmin, so the setup wizard is closed for good.

switcher.label: Switch Workspace or Site
switcher.heading: Switch to
switcher.workspaceSubtitle: Workspace · {count, plural, one {# Site} other {# Sites}}

masterKeyBanner.title: Back up your Master key
masterKeyBanner.body: WEBCRAFT_SECRET_KEY encrypts every SMTP password, AI key and API token on this Install. If it is lost, they cannot be recovered. Keep a copy somewhere other than this server.
masterKeyBanner.confirmed: Thanks. The banner won't show again for this key.

dialog.title: Back up your Master key
dialog.intro: The Master key is never stored in the database or in a Backup, so a copy kept elsewhere is the only way to read your secrets after losing the server.
dialog.stepCopy: On the server, copy the value of WEBCRAFT_SECRET_KEY from the Install's environment: the .env file next to your Docker Compose file, or your platform's environment variables.
dialog.stepStore: Store it in a password manager or another safe place that is not this server and not a Backup.
dialog.stepSecret: Keep it secret: anyone with the key and a Backup can read every stored secret.
dialog.fingerprintHelp: Backups record this fingerprint, so you can tell which key a Backup needs. It reveals nothing about the key.

siteLanguages.nameHelp: As visitors read it in the Language switcher. The language's own name unless you give one.
siteLanguages.domainHelp: Such as bakery.fr. The Site answers on it in this language once domains are verified; on the Staging address the prefix stays.
siteLanguages.editIntro: The code ({code}) stays as it is: it is in every address of the language.
siteLanguages.redirectLabel: Send a first visit to the home page on to the visitor's language
siteLanguages.redirectHelp: Only a visitor's first request to the home page, with no language chosen yet, in a language the home page is shown in. Never for search engines or links to other pages; a language chosen with the Language switcher always wins.
siteLanguages.makeDefaultWarning: {name} loses its prefix and {current} gets one (/{prefix}/…). Translatable fields will fall back to {name}, so values without their own {name} text show nothing there. Shared values keep their value.
siteLanguages.changedPaths: {count, plural, one {# published address changes; the old one is listed for redirects.} other {# published addresses change; the old ones are listed for redirects.}}
siteLanguages.withoutOwnTitle: {count, plural, one {# Entry has no title of its own in {name}.} other {# Entries have no title of their own in {name}.}}
siteLanguages.removeBody: Its pages are gone at once. Values written in {name} are kept: adding it again brings them back.
siteLanguages.removePages: {count, plural, one {{name} has # published page.} other {{name} has # published pages.}}
siteLanguages.appliesAtOnce: Changes to Site settings take effect when saved; they aren't part of Publish all.
siteLanguages.prefixTaken: A published page or a URL pattern of this Site already starts where that language's addresses would. Move it first.

libraries.heading: Libraries
libraries.intro: Script packages, such as animation libraries, that every page of this Site loads before the Site script. WebCraft downloads each once, checks it and serves its own copy from the Site's domain, so it never changes unless you update it.
libraries.listIntro: They load on every page in this order, in Edit mode too, but never in Safe mode.
libraries.upToDate: Every Library is on its newest version.
libraries.updatesFound: {count, plural, one {# Library has a newer version.} other {# Libraries have newer versions.}}
libraries.none: No Libraries yet. Add one below.
libraries.removeText: Pages stop loading it at once. Scripts that use it will fail on pages until you change them.
libraries.addIntro: It is downloaded once and checked now; pages then load the Site's own copy.
libraries.fromRegistry: A package of the npm registry
libraries.fromRegistryHelp: By its name and version. A plugin is its own Library: the same package with the plugin's file.
libraries.fromAddressHelp: An https address of one script file. Its copy never changes unless you download it again.
libraries.versionHelp: An exact version such as 3.13.0, a partial one such as 3.13 for its newest release, or a tag such as latest.
libraries.fileHelp: The file to serve, such as dist/library.min.js. Left empty, the file the package names as its browser build.
libraries.appliesAtOnce: Changes apply at once and aren't part of Publish all.

problems.name: That isn't a package name.
problems.version: Give an exact version (3.13.0), a partial one (3.13) or a tag (latest).
problems.file: Give the path of a .js file inside the package, such as dist/library.min.js.
problems.url: Give an https address of a script file.
problems.notFound: The registry has no such package or version.
problems.fileNotFound: The package has no such file. Give the path of the file to serve.
problems.integrity: What was downloaded doesn't match the package's integrity hash, so it wasn't kept.
problems.size: The file is larger than a Library may be (5 MB).
problems.unreachable: The download didn't work. Check the address, or try again later.
problems.limit: This Site holds as many Libraries as it may.

outsideScripts.heading: Outside scripts
outsideScripts.intro: Tags, pixels and widgets loaded live from other hosts. They never run in Edit mode, and browsers load scripts only from the hosts this Site's policy allows.
outsideScripts.listIntro: Visitors' pages load them where you put them, in this order. A snippet's own code is served from the Site as a file, never written into pages.
outsideScripts.dialogIntro: Give one script address, or paste the snippet a service gives you. The hosts it loads from are allowed by themselves.
outsideScripts.name: Name
outsideScripts.addressHelp: An https address, such as https://widgets.example.com/chat.js.
outsideScripts.snippetHelp: Only '<script>' elements: comments and '<noscript>' parts are left out. Show embeds with a Component instead.
outsideScripts.categoryHelp: Which choice of the Consent banner it belongs to.
outsideScripts.removeText: Pages stop loading it at once. Hosts only it needed are no longer allowed.
outsideScripts.hostsIntro: Besides the Site's own domain, scripts, styles, fonts, frames and requests may come only from these hosts, over https.
outsideScripts.noHosts: No outside hosts are allowed: everything comes from the Site's own domain.
outsideScripts.hostHelp: Such as tags.example.com, or *.example.com for every host under it: for what a tag manager loads, for example.
outsideScripts.hostInvalid: That isn't a host name. Give one such as tags.example.com.
outsideScripts.tooManyHosts: This Site allows as many hosts as it may.
outsideScripts.policyIntro: How browsers hold this Site's pages to its policy. Every page also blocks plugins, framing by other sites and forms posting elsewhere.

modeHelp.strict: Recommended. Scripts run only from the Site and its allowed hosts, never written into pages.
modeHelp.relaxed: Also allows scripts written into pages and eval, which some tag managers need. Outside scripts still can't run in Edit mode.
modeHelp.reportOnly: Browsers report what the Strict policy would block, in their console, without blocking it. Use it to try Strict out.

outsideScripts.appliesAtOnce: Changes apply at once and aren't part of Publish all.

domains.heading: Domains & Staging

intro.caddy: Where this Site is served. Certificates are issued automatically once a domain's DNS points at this Install.
intro.coolify: Where this Site is served. Add each domain in Coolify too: Coolify issues its certificate once its DNS points at this Install.
intro.railway: Where this Site is served. Add each domain in Railway too: Railway issues its certificate once its DNS points there.

domains.primaryIntro: Visitors and search engines see this address.
domains.noPrimary: No domain yet: the Site is only on its Staging address.
domains.redirectsIntro: These send visitors to the Primary domain with a permanent redirect, keeping the path.
domains.languagesIntro: Each serves one language without a prefix. Set them in Languages.
domains.stagingIntro: The Site on the agency's own domain, for reviewing work before launch. Search engines never index it.
domains.noStaging: This Install has no sites domain, so its Sites have no Staging address.

problem.dns: Its DNS doesn't point at this Install.
problem.response: Something other than this Install answered.
problem.certificate-missing: No valid certificate answers for it.
problem.certificate-expiring: Its certificate runs out within 14 days.

domains.onDemand: Checked again when you press Check now
domains.addRedirectPlaceholder: Add a redirect domain, e.g. acme-bakery.ie
domains.addPartnerHelp: A bare domain and its www address are usually added together; the second one redirects to the first.
domains.addedOne: {name} was added. It is checked every few minutes until its DNS points here.
domains.addedTwo: {name} and {partner} were added. They are checked every few minutes until their DNS points here.

records.caddyIntro: At your domain registrar, add these records. The certificate is issued automatically once they resolve.
records.coolifyIntro: In Coolify, add https://{name} to the web service's domains, then add these records at your domain registrar. Coolify issues the certificate.
records.railwayIntro: In Railway, add {name} as a custom domain of the web service, then create the records Railway shows at your domain registrar (a CNAME record, and a TXT record that proves the domain is yours). WebCraft checks the domain once they resolve.
records.name: Name
records.aliasIntro: For a subdomain such as www, a CNAME record to {host} works instead.
records.noAddresses: For a bare domain, ask the Superadmin for this Install's IP address: it isn't set (WEBCRAFT_PUBLIC_ADDRESSES).
records.caption: DNS records for {name}

domains.changeIntro: Choose a verified Redirect domain. The Primary domain now becomes a Redirect domain, so its links keep working.
domains.changeNone: No Redirect domain is verified yet. Add the new domain below as a Redirect domain; once it is verified, make it the Primary domain.
domains.makePrimaryBody: Visitors and search engines will see {name}. {current} becomes a Redirect domain.
domains.removeBody: Removing a domain stops it at once. To move it to another Site, remove it here, then add it there.
domains.removeLive: {name} serves visitors now: it will stop working at once.
domains.removeWaiting: {name} isn't verified yet: nothing is served on it.
domains.removePrimary: Without a Primary domain, the Site is only on its Staging address, and its Redirect domains stop redirecting.
domains.appliesAtOnce: Changes here apply at once: they aren't part of Publish all.

settingProblems.fieldsDepth: Groups and Repeaters nest at most {max} deep.

settingProblems.lengthOrder: The longest length can't be shorter than the shortest.
settingProblems.numberOrder: The largest number can't be smaller than the smallest.
settingProblems.dateMode: Choose a date, a time, or a date and time.
settingProblems.dateOrder: The latest can't be before the earliest.
settingProblems.optionsCount: A select Field has 1 to {max} choices.

settingProblems.pageUrlPattern: Pages are found by their parent Page and slug, so their URL pattern can't change.

settingProblems.urlPatternParts: A URL pattern has at most {max} parts.

media.unknownFile: A file that is no longer in the library
media.dialogHelp: Files of this Site's Media library. Upload new ones on the Media screen.

richText.linkHelp: An http or https address, mailto: or tel:, a path such as /about, or an #anchor. The selected text becomes the link.
richText.linkMissing: Enter the address the link goes to.

image.caption: Caption: {caption}.
image.fromLibrary: Alt text and caption come from the Media library.

table.headerRow: The first row is the header

create.title: New in {name}
create.intro: Give it a title; you write the rest in the editor, saved as a Draft as you go.

editor.slugHelp: Part of the address. It never changes by itself after publishing.
editor.parentHelp: The Page this one sits under; its address starts with the parent's.
editor.publishHelp: Publishing puts this Draft live at once. Authors can only save Drafts; an Editor or Owner publishes.

editor.saveFirst: The latest changes aren't saved yet, so nothing was published.
editor.fixFirst: Not published: fix what's marked first.

delete.title: Delete {title}?
delete.body: It goes for good, from the admin and the Site.
delete.links: {count, plural, one {# other Entry links to it; that link will be removed.} other {# other Entries link to it; those links will be removed.}}

postTypes.intro: Changes apply as soon as you save: Post Types and Fields have no Draft.
postTypes.name: Name
postTypes.urlPatternHelp: Fixed parts and one '{slug}', such as /blog/'{slug}'.
postTypes.urlPatternPagesHelp: Pages are found by their parent Page and slug, so this can't change.

globals.heading: Globals
globals.intro: Site-wide values, such as a phone number or footer text, that every Template reads as site.x. Clients edit them under Content › Globals.

create.title: New Post Type
create.intro: A kind of Entry, such as Blog posts or Team members, with its own address and Fields.
create.keyHelp: Lower-case letters, digits and dashes. Made from the name when left empty; it never changes.
create.nameRequired: Give the Post Type a name.
create.urlPatternRequired: Give the Post Type a URL pattern, such as /blog/'{slug}'.

fields.heading: Fields
fields.empty: No Fields yet. Every Entry still has a title and a slug.
fields.added: {type} Field added. Its settings are open.
fields.removed: {label} removed. Save to remove it from every Entry.
fields.selectHint: Choose a Field to see its settings here.

settings.label: Label
settings.keyHelp: Templates read the Field by this name. It can't change once saved.
settings.keySavedHelp: Templates read the Field by this name, so it never changes.
settings.typeKept: A saved Field keeps its type.
settings.patternHelp: A regular expression the whole value must match, in RE2 syntax: look-around (such as (?=…)) and back-references (such as \1) aren't supported. Leave empty for none.
settings.twoWayHelp: The Entries it points at show the link back.
settings.oneWayHelp: The Entries it points at show nothing of it.
settings.defaultHelp: New Entries start with this value. Existing Entries keep theirs.
settings.requiredHelp: An Entry can't be published without a value here.
settings.requiredGlobalsHelp: The Globals can't be published without a value here.
settings.requiredRelationshipHelp: An Entry can't be published without it, and the Entries it points at can't be deleted while it does.
settings.translatableHelp: Holds a separate value per language.
settings.sharedAlways: A Relationship is shared by every language.
settings.translatedInside: Its Fields are translatable one by one.
settings.blocksHelp: Paragraphs are always on. A Block switched off can't be added; a body that already has one can't be published until it is removed.

globals.heading: Globals
globals.intro: Values every page of the Site shows
globals.empty: This Site has no Globals yet.
globals.publishHelp: Publishing puts these values live on every page at once.

loops.intro: A Loop repeats the same markup for each of its items: Entries a query finds, or its own Loop items. Create one with the + button, then place it in a Template or Component by its name.
loops.markupHint: Place it in Template markup with {opening} … {closing}.

create.title: New Loop
create.intro: Name the Loop as Template markup will write it. Its name never changes.
create.name: Name
create.nameHelp: Lower-case words joined by dashes, such as latest-posts.

source.heading: Items come from
source.queryHelp: Entries of one or more Post Types, filtered and sorted.
source.itemsHelp: The Loop's own list, with Fields you define; clients change its items.
source.fieldHelp: A Repeater or Relationship on the Entry needs no Loop: name it in markup, such as {example}.

fields.heading: Loop items' Fields
fields.intro: Each Loop item has a value for every Field here.

items.heading: Loop items
items.help: Each item shows once where the Loop is placed, in this order.
items.noFields: Add the Loop items' Fields on the Settings tab first.

query.noFilters: No filters: every published Entry of the Post Types.

to.sharedWithCurrent: what the current Entry points at
to.label: To

query.limitHelp: How many items it shows (on each page), 1 to 100.
query.offsetHelp: How many matching Entries it skips first.
query.paginateHelp: On Archive templates and Pages only: show the items page by page, with {example} for the links.
query.excludeCurrentHelp: For "more posts" on an Entry template.

data.loopIntro: The Loop's first item from the Draft, as its bindings read it. Copy a binding into Template markup.
data.entryTemplateIntro: The Entry saved last, from its Draft, as this Post Type's Entry template reads it. Copy a binding into Template markup.
data.globalsIntro: The Globals' Draft values, as every Template reads them. Copy a binding into Template markup.
data.noItem: There is nothing to show yet: add an Entry or a Loop item, or change the query.
data.copyFailed: Couldn't copy {binding}: select it and copy it yourself.

forms.heading: Forms
forms.intro: The Site's Forms: Staff build them here and place them in Templates and Components with '{{@form <key>}}'.

forms.name: Name
forms.keyHelp: How Template markup names it: '{{@form contact}}'. Lower-case words joined by dashes; made from the name when left empty.
forms.placedCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nowhere yet} one {In # place} other {In # places}}
forms.newIntro: Name the Form. It starts as a Draft with no fields.
forms.deleteBody: The Form is deleted for good. Submissions already received stay with the Forms Module.
forms.notPlaced: Not placed on any page yet.
forms.problems: The Form can't be saved yet:
forms.noFields: No fields yet: add one from the list.
forms.selectField: Choose a field to change its settings.

field.messageHelp: Shown for any value the field refuses, in place of WebCraft's own words.

captcha.siteKeyHelp: The provider's public key for this Site.
